work_completed: Narrowed 'wait' (Joshua, 2026-10-28): AvatarCharacter.HoldsStill(verb, hasTarget, nothingVisible) decides whether an untargeted verb holds the avatar still. 'wait' holds still unless the perception it answered listed no entities, in which case it falls through to the wander fallback. Untargeted 'rest' still holds still. A 'wait' while something is under way still lets it carry on. IntentIngress passes nothingVisible = perception.VisibleEntities.Count == 0 into ApplyIntent.

F0 engine side: PerceptionBuilder.Build takes the roster id and WireAgentId puts it in the perception's agentId (blank falls back to the internal key). AgentLoopDriver.PerceptionAgentId is set in Main from NLT_AGENT_LOOP_AGENT_ID, with a startup warning when unset. The internal '__local_avatar__' key, occupancy, in-flight tracking and the observer are unchanged. FusionHttpLink reports a 404 as an agent Fusion does not serve.
AgentHarness: new sections [roster agentId] and [wait with nothing in view].
Docs: docs/agent-loop.md run steps and behaviour, world-engine-godot/AGENTS.md, docs/active-threads.md (new AGENT-LOOP-003 section; decision note under AGENT-LOOP-002).

GRAPH-001 (Joshua, 2026-10-28, overrides brief §3 C2): Resident.Sync plays the walk clip whenever the agent moves, reduced motion or not (Resident.IsWalking, speed > 0.05 m/s); an idle agent still holds the first frame. Facing follows the same flag. AGENTS.md, RENDERER-PLAN.md D.4, ART-PIPELINE.md G3 and docs/active-threads.md now say reduced motion gates only decorative motion (sky rotation, wind sway, camera easing). Harness section [walk cycle and reduced motion].

CodeRabbit on #117: (1) a 'wait' with nothing in view no longer replaces an already running wander fallback (AvatarCharacter.KeepsCurrentWander; AgentBrain.Controller), which had restarted the tour's progress timer every 2 s so a blocked anchor was never given up; (2) FusionHttpLink keys in-flight and backoff by the avatar's internal id again (the roster id had split the keys, bypassing the 5 s backoff); (3) a 404 is named an unregistered agent only when Fusion's body says so, otherwise it points at NLT_AGENT_LOOP_ENDPOINT; (4) docs/agent-loop.md run-check paragraph no longer describes the removed test target.

decisions_made: Joshua, 2026-10-28: 'wait' resumes wander only when nothing is visible; acceptance 4 split into 4a/4b and not met on 4a alone; F0 roster agentId via NLT_AGENT_LOOP_AGENT_ID, internal key unchanged.
'Nothing visible' means the perception the intent answered had an empty visibleEntities list, not the live world at execution time: the rule is about Fusion having had no other choice.
The wander resumed by such a 'wait' uses the existing fallback path (activity 'active'); no new label.
Joshua, 2026-10-28 (GRAPH-001): walk cycles always play while an agent moves; reduced motion gates only sky rotation, wind sway and camera easing.
